items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: this was the original Mills Brothers with John, one of the fine bass players that passed.

ctx.x: It was a soap deal, you know, in New York, and we played for that, and we got paid extra besides playing regular at Connie's Inn. So it worked out real good,
plus the fact that -- and the Mills Brothers were on this too, and this was the original Mills Brothers with John, one of the fine bass players that passed.
